[[File:Icon-Episode-I.png|40px]]

'''Episode I''' is an expansion-set icon on cards from [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]], [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] and [[Theed Palace]], and on 61 [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III]] cards. Those cards are legal in the full ''Star Wars'' CCG pool. They may also be combined for a stand-alone Episode I environment, the [[Episode I Closed Environment]].
